<!-- pr-reviewer: 7afbcbaf6e0bd3ab79c173fa77c119ad4a1b0c08 -->

**Verdict: Needs changes before merge.** The design and the code are good. One process blocker is below.

## What looks good

- The grammar change is additive and optional. `check_input_form` (crates/post/src/machine/installation.rs:53) only refuses a mixed input when the new facts are present, so every existing machine file loads exactly as before.
- `assets/machines/AGENTS.md` documents `controller.identity` and `tooling.tool_change` and keeps the rule clear: the file states facts, the post owns the syntax. That matches #3181: the Klartext rules stay out of the machine file.
- The exact release identifier `340490-03` is stored and pinned by tests at both post entry points (crates/post/tests/machine_controller.rs, crates/app/tests/machine_controller.rs).
- Validation refuses degenerate input by name: empty or padded identifiers, duplicate options, and unknown `tool_change` values.
- Unknown versus empty options is a real distinction and the sheet test covers all three states.
- Placement and layering are correct: the data lives in `post::machine`, `app` displays it, no schema component was added, and each new test file names its Gate map in its crate's own tests.
- No new crate dependencies, provenance lines on each new module, and a decision entry at docs/decisions/3181-machine-control.md.
- The cited sources (HEIDENHAIN's published manual, Fehlmann's manuals and the installation's parameter file) are allowed reference material.

## Results

**Not built by this review.** This is a fork PR; its code does not run on our self-hosted runner, and this review had no local build slot. I relied on your verification report in the body: quick gate 378 steps and heavy gate 199 steps green on this head `7afbcbaf6`.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Trial merge with main `d66400b78` | Clean (`git merge-tree`, no conflicts) |
| Build / tests / clippy | Not run here (author reports both gates green on this head) |
| Law check (AGENTS.md) | One blocker, below |

Heavy lanes: the diff reaches the post and app heavy lanes. Your body reports the full heavy gate green on this head; this review did not rerun it.

## Requested before merge

1. **Bump `PROJECT_VERSION` (74 -> 75) for the new saved fields.** The machine record in a saved project now carries `controller_identity` and `tool_change` (crates/app/tests/machine_controller.rs:64-67 asserts them in the saved JSON), but `crates/app/src/project/file.rs:157` still writes version 74. A build from before this PR opens such a project, ignores the two unknown fields (`Machine` has no `deny_unknown_fields`), and silently drops them on the next save. That is the exact case the v72 -> v73 and v73 -> v74 notes in apply.rs guard: "An old reader must refuse a v74 file rather than drop" stated facts. The step-up itself is a no-op (an older file simply gains the fields as unstated), so it needs only the constant, the doc-comment rung in file.rs (crates/app/src/project/file.rs:150-156), and the note in the apply.rs migration chain (crates/app/src/project/apply.rs:539-544). Your round-trip test then also pins the new version.

## Questions / notes (not blocking)

- crates/post/src/post/machine.rs grew from 387 to 402 lines. AGENTS.md wants about 400. A split along a domain seam in #3182 would be good; it is not a blocker here.
- `script_props` now returns `{"error": reason}` for invalid input (crates/post/src/post/machine.rs:224-227). The engine refuses earlier (crates/post/src/post/engine.rs:112), so no user path can show that object; only tests call the function directly. A short doc comment saying so would help the next reader.
- The script `machine` global gains `spindleMin` for every machine (0.0 when unstated, which matches how `spindleMax` already reads). The key list in assets/machines/AGENTS.md around line 331 is not updated for the new keys (`spindleMin`, `controllerIdentity`, `linearAxes`, `toolChangeMode`). Consider adding one line for each.
- Thank you for the clear evidence section. The outstanding physical-machine checks you list are well placed in the decision entry, and the split into this PR plus #3182 reads well.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: e6e04f5d05e4d324ec8d758f6a5ef54a8181a06d -->

**Verdict: clean read-only review - no blockers. Not built by this review (outside fork PR).** A maintainer will approve and merge by hand; a `feat` merges at the minor cut.

## The earlier blocker is resolved

- `PROJECT_VERSION` is now 75 (`crates/app/src/project/file.rs:160`). The migration note is in `crates/app/src/project/apply.rs:544`. `crates/app/src/project/mod.rs` no longer repeats the number in prose, so it cannot drift again.
- A v74 reader refuses a v75 file, and a v74 file opens with both facts unstated. `crates/app/tests/machine_controller.rs:83` pins both readings, and the refusal of a future version is pinned at line 114.

## What looks good

- The grammar change is additive and optional. `deny_unknown_fields` on `ControllerIdentity` refuses a misspelled key by name (`crates/post/src/machine/installation.rs:8`).
- Mixed input is refused before it can drop a stated limit: `check_input_form` (`crates/post/src/machine/installation.rs:53`) and `checked_input` (`crates/post/src/post/engine.rs:112`) guard the file form at the parse and post seams. All `engine::run*` entry points meet at the checked seam.
- Machine facts now reach the script `machine` global through one checked path. This closes the earlier gap where `script_props` and the transforms could see different forms.
- The three earlier notes are all addressed: `crates/post/src/post/machine.rs` is 396 lines (the helper moved to `machine_rotary.rs`, the installation view to `machine_installation.rs`); the `script_props` error arm is now documented for direct callers (`crates/post/src/post/machine.rs:226`); `spindleMin`, `controllerIdentity`, `linearAxes` and `toolChangeMode` are listed in `assets/machines/AGENTS.md`.
- Tests cover both post entry points, the raw and saved forms, option lists (`absent` vs `[]` vs stated), duplicate and whitespace identifiers, and reopening. No `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic!` outside tests in the added source.
- The Picomax file states only sourced facts and names its unstated limits, as the decision file explains.

## Results

- Not built here: the PR is from an account without push access, so the review is read-only (diff and source read at head `e6e04f5d0`, merged cleanly with `origin/main` in the merge plan: MERGEABLE).
- The author reports on this head: quick gate 449 steps with 3,411 passes, heavy gate 199 steps with 43 release passes, strict clippy clean, and a v74-build refusal check. This review cannot confirm those runs.
- Heavy lanes: the diff reaches the `app` and `post` heavy lanes (the machine and Heidenhain golden lanes). The PR body names a green heavy run on `e6e04f5d0`. This review did not run it; the maintainer may want one confirmation run before the cut.

## Requested before merge

- Nothing blocking.

## Questions / notes (not blocking)

1. `check_input_form` error text (`crates/post/src/machine/installation.rs:89`): when the found key is `kinematics.static`, the sentence "must use the file form" reads oddly, because the file already has `kinematics.default.parts`. A form like "remove the static key <name>, or state the facts in a plain file-form machine" would name the fix.
2. `installed_options` duplicate refusal (`installation.rs:33`) does not name the duplicated option. Naming it would fit the refuse-by-name style.
3. Format-bump labeling: AGENTS.md calls a project-format bump a breaking change (`!` or `BREAKING CHANGE:`). The bump commit is `fix(project):` with no marker; recent bumps on main (for example `d3f0b9661`) used the same plain style, so this note is for the maintainer, not the contributor.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
